proposed_fixes.title: Resolve extensionless batch commands using executable-extension semantics
plan: Add controlled tests for the existing Find-and-run branch with batch names, arguments, whitespace and explicit extensions.
Resolve executable extensions consistently with Windows/PATHEXT expectations without changing explicit paths, quoting, RunAs or shell-selection behavior.
Keep the command/argument boundary intact and retain existing executable and leave-shell-open behavior.
verification: Inert fixture lookup: extensionless .bat/.cmd, explicit .bat, extensionless .exe, absent name and quoted/path-with-space cases.
Controlled harmless batch writes received arguments into a test-owned file; compare extensionless/explicit forms with and without args in Find-and-run and pwsh modes.
No reporter eject/sync command or arbitrary PATH program is executed.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: ExistInPath checks only the literal name and .exe, so an extensionless PATH batch file is routed differently from its explicit .bat form when arguments are present.

confidence.rationale: Exact source compilation proves the lookup gap; full invocation/quoting behavior and desired PATHEXT contract still need maintainer regression execution.

evidence: Original report gives the precise matrix: extensionless batch plus arguments fails, explicit .bat or no arguments works.
Latest reply confirms the issue and narrows it to Find and run the executable file; pwsh execution works. The requested author confirmation has been answered.
Current Shell.Main.ExistInPath probes filename and filename+.exe in PATH, not the configured executable extensions.

Compiled the exact current ExistInPath method and tested a private PATH containing inert fixtures: extensionless batch=false, explicit batch=true, extensionless executable=true. No batch or executable was launched.
judgment.recommended_action: Investigate executable-extension-aware lookup and add the supplied mode/argument matrix; do not request the already answered confirmation or execute the reporter drive-ejection script.
judgment.rationale: The current method reproduces the lookup discriminator. This supports a focused lookup fix, not a broad shell-command rewrite. Full invocation, quoting and argument preservation still need controlled regression tests before claiming the complete user scenario repaired.

fix_assessment.rationale: Exact current lookup proof and execution-mode evidence support a localized proposal; full command execution remains to validate.

steps: Choose Find and run the executable file and invoke >probe arg1, then >probe.bat arg1.
Repeat both names without arguments, then repeat in pwsh execution mode.
Verify exact received arguments and compare a normal executable control.
prerequisites: Test-owned PATH directory with a harmless batch that records only its arguments.
Record Shell command-execution and leave-shell-open settings.
reproduce.expected: Extensionless batch lookup respects supported executable-extension semantics, arguments remain intact, and no unrelated command is selected.
